plates.title: WHAT DID THE INTERVAL KEEP?
plates.focus: Finite rates, height-times-width area estimates and signed net change retain different things; held comparisons and finite reference sums do not reach a mathematical limit.
plates.summary: A joining line misses a crest. Rectangles offer an area estimate; a held reading remains beside another. At an arch, a climb and descent cancel in the total without erasing the journey.
plates.footer: Zero net change does not mean that nothing happened.

The held display shows cropped finer/coarser samples without an exact visible count. The 4,096-sample reference remains finite; the arch tableau does not certify a walkable reconstruction.

plates.title: THE NEXT READING
plates.focus: Direction sampled at the present position prescribes each next step; held field time differs from stopped particles, wraps differ from trail joins, and nearby particles do not interact.
plates.summary: A large wall screen holds a field while its particles move. Every step changes the next lookup; a drawn trail can invent a journey across a wrap. Nearby routes share a picture without making room for each other.
plates.footer: A route begins without a list of destinations.
